_comment: Branch row and cities, hand-written because this deployment has no database. Everything a trading business would have - phone, email, WhatsApp, hours, reviews - is null ON PURPOSE: EVS has not opened in Bangladesh.

branch.name: EVS Bangladesh
branch._country_name_the: English says "in Bangladesh", not "in the Bangladesh", so this stays null and branchTokens() falls back to country_name.

_cities_comment: ONE CITY. Dhaka holds effectively all of the registered four-wheel EV parc, and a single centre there is what EVS is opening. Chattogram (~250 km) and Sylhet (~240 km) are discussed in the body copy as separate markets with no claim of premises. Add a city here only when there is a workshop in it.
